tasks.description:
## Goal
Build and independently verify a tiny tip calculator in the specified tipcalc folder.

## Your part
An independent check of your work FAILED. This is attempt 2: fix only what failed, and keep everything else as it is.
The checker reported: Independent verification found a split rounding defect: floating-point artifacts make some exact-cent inputs round up by an extra cent. No files were changed; no commit was created.
Failing checks:
- FAIL exports-rounding Exports and cent rounding: src/tip.js exports tip and split. tip probes and usual split cases passed, but split(0.07, 1) returns 0.08 instead of 0.07; split(0.14, 2) returns 0.08 instead of 0.07. `Math.ceil(total * 100 / people)` is vulnerable to floating-point rounding above exact cent values.
- FAIL independent-review Independent implementation review: The implementation does not fully meet the cent-rounding acceptance criterion because split returns an extra cent for valid exact-cent inputs such as 0.07 split between one person and 0.14 split between two people.
Your part as first given, for reference: In <work>/tasks/three-member-dependency-1/tipcalc, build a tiny tip calculator. Implement src/tip.js exporting tip(amount, percent), with the tip rounded to the cent, and split(total, people), with each person's share rounded up to the cent. Add tests in test/tip.test.js that run with node --test, and an index.html page that uses it. Keep the implementation focused. Run node --test and report the changed files and results.

## Constraints
- Where: computer any; folder <work>/tasks/three-member-dependency-1/tipcalc.
- Publish: nothing: do not commit or push.
- Features go one at a time: each is checked before the next starts.
- Parallel work: one checkout of the folder; steps that change it take turns.
- Use the named folder only. No project, task, or repository was specified.
- Developer implements first; tester independently checks the developer's result afterward.

## Who you are
You are the coding agent for Mira Chen, working through their Ensemble node @developer (developer) on step 1 of 2 of a plan led by @manager. Other agents may be working on other steps at the same time: stay within your part and do not undo their changes. - summary: what changed and how you checked it.
- subject: what you built or tested: repo, branch and commit; without a commit, `git write-tree` as contentHash.
